title: Invoice export drops line items with zero quantity
body:
Scope: packages/billing/invoices

Repro: create an invoice with a line item that has quantity=0 (e.g. a fully-refunded item), then export it to CSV via /billing/invoices/:id/export. The exported CSV silently omits that line item.

Expected: every line item on the invoice appears in the export, including zero-quantity ones - their subtotal is 0 but they still represent a real adjustment for accounting.

Actual: the export filters out any line item where quantity === 0, so accounting can't reconcile the invoice against the export.

Acceptance criteria: exporting an invoice with a zero-quantity line item includes that line item in the CSV output with its correct (zero) subtotal.
